card.text: HD 50554 b was found in 2002 by Lick Observatory by radial velocity; it does not cross its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 50554 b"
sources.quote: HD 50554 b is a Jupiter-sized exoplanet with a minimum mass 4.4 times that of Jupiter.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 50554. Its orbit, tilt included, follows Xiao et al. 2023's fit, and its size is the archive's model from its mass.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 50554 b"
sources.quote: The planet was announced in 2001 by the European Southern Observatory and formally published in 2002 using observations from the Lick and Keck telescopes.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
